But you {{ls}}ee me: becau{{ls}}e I liue, and you {{ls}}hal liue.⊣ {{verse|chapter=14|verse=20}} In that day you {{ls}}hal knovv that I am in my father, and you in me, and I in you. {{verse|chapter=14|verse=21}} He that hath my commaundements, and keepeth them: he it is that loueth me. And he that loueth me, {{ls}}hal be loued of my father: and I vvil loue him, and vvil manife{{ls}}t my {{ls}}elf to him.⊣

{{verse|chapter=14|verse=22}} Iudas {{ls}}aith to him, not that I{{ls}}cariote, Lord, vvhat is done, that thou vvilt manife{{ls}}t thy {{ls}}elf to vs, and not to the vvorld? {{verse|chapter=14|verse=23}} {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=The Go{{ls}}pel vpō Whit{{ls}}unday. And the vvord vvhich you haue heard, is not mine: but his that {{ls}}ent me, the Fathers. {{verse|chapter=14|verse=25}} The{{ls}}e things haue I {{ls}}poken to you abiding vvith you. {{verse|chapter=14|verse=26}} But the Paraclete the holy Gho{{ls}}t, vvhom the Father vvil {{ls}}end in my name, he {{ls}}hal {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ See the Annot. vpon the 16 Chap. vs. 12 & 13.}}∷ teach you al things, & {{ls}}ugge{{ls}}t vnto you al things vvhat{{ls}}oeuer I {{ls}}hal {{ls}}ay to you. {{verse|chapter=14|verse=27}} Peace I leaue to you, my peace I giue to you. not as the vvorld giueth, doe I giue to you. Let not your hart be troubled, nor feare. {{verse|chapter=14|verse=28}} You haue heard that I {{ls}}aid to you, I goe and I come to you. If you loued me, you vvould be glad verily, that I goe to the Father: becau{{ls}}e the {{sup|‖}} Father is greater then I. {{verse|chapter=14|verse=29}} And novv I haue told you before it come to pa{{ls}}{{ls}}e: that vvhen it {{ls}}hal come to pa{{ls}}{{ls}}e, you may beleeue. {{verse|chapter=14|verse=30}} Novv I vvil not {{ls}}peake many things vvith you. for the prince of this vvorld commeth, and in me he hath not any thing. {{verse|chapter=14|verse=31}} But that the vvorld may knovv that I loue the Father: and as the Father hath giuen me commaundement, {{ls}}o doe I: ⊣ Ari{{ls}}e, let vs goe hence.
